author: SnowSX3
body:
Reported Player(s): Beaverhat
Rules Broken:  A3, B4
"...the following actions below is strictly against the rules...Spamming chat. This involves repeatedely sending similar or identical messages to the point in which it may be bothersome and annoying to other users..."

"Do not publicly accuse players are hacking."


Evidence:  http://imgur.com/5f3kE2n,ixlZzhf,ADCtlpE,V6xEI3G,V6rZ3qa,aEdZfXQ
6 images.

This player has 3 infractions, 2 are chat-related.
One was a warn for accusing others of hacking.
The other was a kick for spamming in the chat.

As you can see, this player has done both of that in the images.
This player was also very rude.
